$comment: C31 presentation sidecar (task 5.2, R10.3). Keyed by Semantic_ID. Carries ONLY presentation decisions the model and the default uiType table cannot supply. Everything derivable — filledBy, visibleWhen, codelist, required, repeatable, and (see below) i18n label keys — is generated and must NOT be restated here.
$finding.i18nKeysAreDerivable: The original R10 design assumed i18n label/title keys would need hand-authoring here. They do not. The shipped catalogue (i18n/i18n/en/espd.part4.json) is keyed by '<kind>.label.<criterion-code>.<EA tag path>', which the compiler derives from requestpath + nodeKind; all 17 C31 leaf keys resolve. Note the hand-authored model/form-structure/part-IV.form.json invents its own keys ('part4.selection.turnover.numberOfYears', ...) and NONE of its 21 keys resolve against the catalogue. The generated lens uses the real, resolvable keys instead.

groupLabels.$note: Group ids derive from the shared instance-path segment. A group whose leaves share no prefix gets the first leaf's segment, which is serviceable but not a name a human would choose. These are display-name overrides only; they do not affect dataPath or ordering.

propertyLabelKeys.$note: The i18n catalogue is LEAF-level: one key per leaf. Where the form renders several inputs for a single leaf (PERIOD -> two dates, AMOUNT -> value + currency, EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER -> url/identifier/description), the per-input sub-labels have no leaf key and are supplied here, keyed by instance property. Declared per VALUE TYPE rather than per field, so one entry serves every criterion.
propertyLabelKeys.$note.keysMustExist: Every key below resolves in i18n/i18n/en/espd.common.json; a test asserts this. `ui.evidenceUrl`, `ui.evidenceIssuer` and `ui.evidenceReference` already shipped. The remaining five are NEW keys added to the catalogue for the sub-label cases, following the existing `ui.*` convention — not invented in this file and left dangling (which is the flaw in the hand-authored part-IV.form.json).

uiTypeOverrides.$note: Overrides where the value-type default is wrong for this specific field (R6.5). DESCRIPTION defaults to 'textarea'; the relied-upon entity name is a short single-line value, so it renders as 'text'. This is the exact case R6.5 anticipates.
